defensiveAbilities.name: Collapse Into Sand
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The sand wolf is hit by an attack

Effect The sand wolf's body falls apart into a cloud of sand. It takes no damage from the triggering attack, and its resistances increase to 8. The sand wolf must spend one action to reform its body before it can move or attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Water Vulnerability
defensiveAbilities.description: Sand wolves take 5 additional damage from attacks and effects with the water trait.

offensiveAbilities.name: Choking Sands
offensiveAbilities.description:
The sand wolf discorporates into a cloud of whirling sand. It can Stride, moving freely through occupied spaces. Any creatures within those spaces take 2d10 damage and must attempt a DC 19 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The target takes no damage.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is Sickened 1.

Critical Failure As failure, but the effect is increased to Sickened 3.

offensiveAbilities.name: Susurrating Song
offensiveAbilities.description:
The sand wolf sings a short, enchanting song. Any creature other than a sand wolf within 30 feet must attempt a DC 19 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to further susurrating song exposures for 24 hours.

Success The target is Stupefied 1.

Failure The target is Stupefied 2.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is Slowed 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
